relationships.subject: Suzetrigine
relationships.evidence_quote: Suzetrigine is a first-in-class, oral peripheral sodium channel inhibitor that selectively targets Nav1.8 channels

relationships.subject: Suzetrigine
relationships.evidence_quote: In phase 3 trials, suzetrigine demonstrated superior efficacy to placebo in reducing pain intensity after surgery and was generally well tolerated.

key_findings: Suzetrigine is an oral peripheral Nav1.8 inhibitor approved for moderate to severe acute pain.
Phase 3 trials showed superior efficacy to placebo after surgery; trials in diabetic neuropathy and lumbosacral radiculopathy are ongoing.
